name: W5 Solutions AB (publ)
summary: W5 Solutions AB (publ) is a Swedish firm specializing in advanced technological systems and services for the defense and civil security sectors within Sweden. Established in 1940 and headquartered in Nacka, it functions as a subsidiary of Swedish Defense Group Ab. The company's comprehensive offerings encompass live fire training and simulation solutions. Moreover, W5 Solutions provides an array of integrated products and systems, including communication apparatus like intercoms and radio accessories, diverse power supply units such as generators, ground power units, auxiliary power units, and uninterruptible power sources. Their portfolio also features critical mission systems, specifically electro-optical/infrared technologies and anti-UAV defense mechanisms, alongside specialized cables, bespoke systems, and essential ground support equipment. Complementing these products, the company offers extensive support and expert consulting services.
